findings.claim: The analysis recommends a macOS-only unsigned local acceptance target without evaluating whether the seeded goal's signed/platform/publication scope decision requires any candidate or evidence for other platforms/signing/publication.
findings.evidence: Goals require “(3) determine signed/platform/publication scope and its release owner,” while the recommendation says “Complete a bounded unsigned macOS ARM64 local acceptance delivery” and later says “Signed/installed macOS, Intel/Windows and publication need separately selected requirements, native hosts/owners and authority; their availability has not been established.” This records deferral, but the candidate table contains no signing/notarization, Windows/Intel, or publication/release-owner candidate evaluation beyond declaring them unselected.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit analyze subsection/candidate disposition for signing, installation, Intel/Windows, and publication ownership explaining why each is rejected/deferred for this phase or what decision evidence Spec must obtain.
